jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(5)(A) inventory: Pittsfield School District, a town school district in the Mountain Views Supervisory Union (member town: Pittsfield). Non-operating: tuitions all students.
Town of Pittsfield (official site; hosts the district's reports).

board.post_note: Pittsfield SD: three directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423, one elected each year at the annual school district meeting. One seat is held (see the source note).

sources.note: Pittsfield Annual Town & School District Report FY25 (official; published Jan. 2026): "2025 Elected Officials" lists Dubois exp 2028, Sperber exp 2027, Rice exp 2026; the March 4, 2025 school meeting minutes (pp. 11-12) record Peter Dubois elected to a three-year term. The board is three directors (16 V.S.A. section 423), one elected yearly. Raymond Rice's seat is HELD: his published term expired at the March 3, 2026 annual meeting and no return was fetched (resolving document: the March 3, 2026 school meeting minutes / FY26 town report).

directors.name: Peter Dubois
directors.note: Elected March 4, 2025 (school meeting minutes in the FY25 report). The directors' report signs "Peter DuBois."
